title: Onboarding IO Stability Proofs and Rollback Playbook for Versioned Models
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a reproducible, auditable onboarding checklist and automated verification suite that proves a model version meets IO stability guarantees for pinned deployments. Deliverables: (1) formalized IO stability proof artifacts (prompt/response fixtures, parameter aliasing matrix, allowed parameter ranges), (2) automated regression harness that runs against published perf profiles, (3) a rollback playbook and keystores for quick unpinning + fallback mapping, and (4) docs for Console to display stability status and proof links.
background: We routinely onboard new model builds and allow customers to pin to exact versions. Past incidents showed subtle IO changes (newline handling, JSON key ordering, tokenization differences) caused regressions in downstream production prompts after pinning. We need a standardized verification artifact bundle (the 'stability proof') that sits alongside the model manifest and is validated automatically during onboarding and before any pinned promotion.
acceptance_criteria: A stability-proof JSON artifact is generated for every onboarded model that documents canonical prompt fixtures, expected normalized outputs, and a parameter alias table.

Automated harness runs nightly against the perf profile and flags regressions by IO fingerprint and token-distribution drift; failures create a blocking ticket and prevent promotion to 'pinned' state.
Console shows a clear 'stability pass/fail' badge with links to artifacts and last-run timestamps.
Rollback playbook documents steps to map pinned clients to fallback variants (model-compat map) and tests the unpin workflow in staging.
Integration tests for aliasing (parameter name/semantics) pass across 10 canonical prompts covering chat, JSON-output, and structured tool-calls.
Onboarding PR includes a sample artifact for at least one open model and a passing CI run in GitHub Actions.
decision_log: 2025-02-12: Decided to use a lightweight 'stability-proof' JSON schema instead of a heavier protobuf so artifacts are human-readable and editable by SEs (Decision by Marcus, Priya).

2025-02-25: Chose to gate promotion to 'pinned' only on passing IO regression checks and basic latency/stability smoke tests (Marcus, Noah).

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overly strict IO checks block valid model improvements. Mitigation: allow a 'semver-like' compatibility tier and an approval flow for semantic IO changes.
Risk: Customers rely on exact byte-level outputs. Mitigation: surface 'exact-match' vs 'semantically-equivalent' flags in stability-proof and provide migration guidance in Console.
Risk: Running exhaustive fixture checks increases onboarding time. Mitigation: run full harness asynchronously; require smoke checks for initial pinning and full validation before GA promotion.
test_plan: Unit tests for stability-proof generator (serialization, alias mapping)
Integration tests: harness runs against staging model pool with seeded responses and compares IO fingerprints
Golden-file tests: store canonical outputs and compare with fuzzy-match tolerances
E2E staging test: simulate pinning a model, run traffic replay, validate fallback mapping when unpin occurs
Chaos test: introduce tokenization shifts in a test build and ensure harness flags regression and that rollback playbook restores traffic in < 5m
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): generate stability-proof artifacts for 3 internal models, enable CI harness, surface badge in Console-beta (Target: 2025-03-01)
Phase 2 (internal): require proof for any model requested for 'customer-readiness' and run SRE rollback drills (Target: 2025-03-10)
Phase 3 (public): make stability-proof optional for self-serve onboarding, default for Dedicated/Private pinned releases; document opt-in policy and support path (Target: 2025-03-31)
qa_checks: Console badge renders with link to last-run artifact
Staging pin flow blocks if harness indicates failing IO fingerprints
Rollback playbook validated end-to-end via runbook-execution in staging
metrics: Pinned-promotion-failure-rate: percent of promotion attempts blocked by harness
notes: Avoid coupling the proof artifact to a specific tokenization library; store both normalized and raw-tokenized reference outputs to help downstream compatibility adapters. Coordinate with Tokenization team for canonicalizer integration.
final_comment: Next steps: finalize schema v0.2 incorporating normalization rules, complete PR reviews for harness integration, and schedule SRE rollback drill week of 2025-03-10. Assignee to update this ticket after the staging drill with measured Time-to-unpin.
